research.title: Calibration Evaluation for Tabular Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned evaluation routines for logistic regression probability estimates, using predefined data splits and calibration settings.
Generated reliability diagrams and checked Brier score calculations against library outputs, documenting discrepancies for group review.

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Processing
bullets: Maintained Python routines that validated incoming tabular records, standardized missing values, and routed malformed entries for review.
Added regression tests for parsing edge cases and investigated processing failures using application logs and reproducible input examples.

projects.title: Regularized Regression for Household Energy Demand
bullets: Implemented ordinary least squares and ridge regression baselines with scikit-learn, applying training-set standardization to household energy predictors.
Compared validation errors across regularization settings and examined residual plots for systematic differences between low and high consumption observations.
